candidates.name: SETUP_TIME_COMPRESSION_EXPANSION_RESERVATION
candidates.hypothesis: The positive immediate C34 opportunity signal should be preserved if queue competition is resolved before the pullback/trigger path: reserve the strongest setup-time expansion in each simultaneous setup cohort, then allow its ordinary trigger to execute immediately without C36's harmful batching delay.
candidates.score: setup-time positive return of final completed 5m block / median normalized high-low range of the preceding eleven completed 5m blocks
rules: at each completed setup timestamp, compute the score from exactly sixty already-completed one-minute bars
reserve exactly one setup with the highest score; use lexical signal id for deterministic ties
after reservation, retain the unchanged C34 trigger-time causal percentile >= 0.60 gate with at least 20 observations
execute the ordinary next-open trigger path without post-trigger waiting; retain entry-drift and structural-stop checks
use no outcome, future candle, final excursion, symbol tuning, risk relaxation or protection bypass

holdoutPolicy: Do not open walk-forward or reserved holdout unless C37 passes every development gate.
